title: Correct force range endpoints
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide both minimum and maximum force expressions, matching the reference forms or algebraically equivalent ones.

title: System acceleration relation
description: Important Criteria: The solution should correctly relate the applied force F to the common acceleration of the wedges using Newton's second law on the combined system.

title: Force balance on top wedge
description: Important Criteria: The student must set up correct force equations (vertical and horizontal) for wedge A, resolving the normal and friction forces from wedge B.

title: Friction direction and limits
description: Important Criteria: The reasoning must correctly identify the direction of static friction on A for both limiting cases (min and max F) and apply f ≤ μN.

title: Algebraic manipulation to solve
description: Optional Criteria: The solution shows clear steps in solving the simultaneous equations to find the acceleration and then substituting to find F_min and F_max.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The final expressions have correct dimensions of force (e.g., terms like mg or μmg are present).

title: Sign error in friction
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the friction force on A is given the wrong sign relative to the impending motion direction for a limiting case.

title: Incorrect system mass
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the total mass in the system acceleration equation is not 3m (i.e., m + M with M=2m).
